subject: Follow-up: sorry we missed you — two quick rebook options
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: sorry we missed you — two quick rebook options

Hi Jamie —

Sorry we missed the slot earlier. I know travel days and calendar collisions are brutal — hope you're OK. Quick note to re-engage with two low-friction options so we can get you unblocked without too much calendar gymnastics: 

Option A — 20-minute "concierge" walkthrough (recorded): we highlight the parts of Redwood that map to your use cases (latency SLA, routing, private deployments). Good for exec + engineering.
Proposed windows (PT):
  • Tue 4/6 11:00 AM – 11:20 AM PT
  • Wed 4/7 3:30 PM – 3:50 PM PT

Option B — Full demo + QA (45–50 minutes): deep dive with an engineer, live pilot/playbook review.
Proposed windows (PT):
  • Thu 4/8 10:00 AM – 10:50 AM PT
  • Fri 4/9 1:00 PM – 1:50 PM PT

If either of those works, reply with the slot you prefer and I will send an invite (or you can pick directly: https://cal.redwood.com/evelyn/concierge-slots). I attached a short one-pager that recaps what we planned to cover and a simple mutual action plan you can share with stakeholders.

If now is a bad time or you want us to loop a different contact in, tell me who and I will coordinate.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0187

Attachments:
  - redwood-demo-one-pager.pdf (1 page)
  - mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

We definitely want to move forward; the team cares most about predictable latency and private deployment options. My engineer Nicole will also want to join. I can do the shorter concierge session this week if that helps accelerate approval internally. 

My availability (PT):
  • Tue 4/6: 11:00–12:00
  • Wed 4/7: 14:00–16:00

If you can hold the 11:00 AM Tue slot while I confirm internally, I should be able to lock it. Adding Nicole in the thread — she can confirm. Sorry again for the scramble.

— Jamie

jamie.park@finlytics.com

Quick logistics + what we’ll send ahead:
- Run-of-show (5 min): objectives and success criteria
- Live demo (10–12 min): routing policies, latency SLOs, Private deployment snippets (VPC onboarding overview)
- Next steps (3–5 min): pilot checklist and trial pricing estimate

If you prefer Option B instead we can expand to a 45-min slot and include one of our solution engineers for a deeper infra walkthrough. 

Attached: mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx (filled partially with suggested stakeholders/next steps) and a one-pager. If Nicole is joining please let us know any specific endpoints or compliance items you want covered (e.g., KMS/HSM integration, retention controls).

If it helps, I can also send a short Loom recording of the parts we’ll demo ahead of time.
